# Sections

The opening of the whole note, which is what a link with no heading shows.

## How it works

Each note gets an address, and new notes are filed behind whichever note they answer.

## Nothing under here

## Deeper

### A sub-heading

Still inside Deeper, because a deeper heading does not end the section.

## Last

Closing text under the last heading.

## Hidden
